releases.body:
First public release of `opencode-model-price-intel`.

- `/models` decoration with input/output/cache prices and Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index scores
- `/model-pricing` table and `/prices` alias
- Live AA fetch with bundled v5.0 snapshot fallback and 12h cache
- Install: `opencode plugin add opencode-model-price-intel`

See `CHANGELOG.md` for details.
